input.prompt: Locked-camera 16:9 ambient effects overlay for an ORIGINAL Sun-and-Moon temple tower-defense map. Plain near-black compositing background. Animate ONLY separated environmental effects: warm sun motes drifting in upper half, cool moon motes drifting in lower half, tiny waterfall mist wisps, soft flame-bowl flicker glows, slow rotating light-ring particles, a few lotus-petal motes. Keep most of frame dark/empty for Unity compositing. Slow loop-friendly motion, no terrain, no buildings, no text, no UI, no camera movement, no cuts.
